lang.“六翼恶魔”枭的大名在世界上无人不知无人不晓。\n:
The name of the 'Six-Winged Demon' Xiao is known to everyone in the world.
Under Leo's leadership, the Demon Clan has achieved countless victories, many of which were battles won against greater numbers.
Although he leads the Demon Clan, Leo is actually a simple-minded person. He always gives his all to charge towards his goals and eliminate any obstacles he encounters.
lang.杰西卡从小喜欢枪械大炮，特别是喜欢开火后的声音，爆破声越大，她越:
Jessica has always loved firearms and cannons since she was a child, especially the sound they make when fired. The louder the explosion, the crazier she becomes, as if she has taken a stimulant.
As she grew older, she paid a high price to have a mechanical master make her a portable cannon, which she treats like her boyfriend, always enjoying the joy brought by the sound of artillery on the battlefield.
lang.凯瑟琳成为精灵族的英雄已经是上世纪的事了。她曾击退老龙王捍卫了森:
Katherine becoming a hero of the elves is a story from the last century. She once repelled the ancient dragon king to defend the forest tribe and was also elected as the first queen of the elven kingdom.
Katherine, who is highly respected, has remained unmarried to this day. It is said that handsome young men often visit her residence.
lang.旅行商人莎德拉在大陆上游历，她标志性的是随身背着的庞大“设备”。:
The traveling merchant Shadra travels across the continent, and her iconic feature is the enormous 'equipment' she carries with her.
Whenever she has free time, she tinkers with her 'equipment' and makes strange little parts and potions to sell to users from all over to earn money. However, she often causes accidents, breaking several pairs of glasses and making a mess of things.
lang.血族传说中的暗杀者，擅长使用影子法术，往往敌人群中一道黑影飘过，:
The legendary assassin of the bloodline, skilled in using shadow magic, often passing through a group of enemies with a black shadow, followed by severed heads falling.
She enjoys teasing her prey, often blowing air lightly behind their necks from one side, then swinging her scythe from the other side as they turn around.
lang.血族的王子，同时也是最强剑士，手持魔剑但丁，剑下亡魂无数。\n:
The prince of the bloodline, also the strongest swordsman, wielding the magic sword Dante, slaying countless souls.
With every enemy she kills, her magic sword absorbs their soul and grows stronger. She is interested in beautiful things, mainly women, but occasionally men as well.
lang.伊利亚从故乡的森林出来后已经冒险很久了，但还是不擅长与人打交道。: Ilya has been on an adventure for a long time since leaving the forest in his hometown, but he is still not good at interacting with people. He can communicate with animals, which always surround him. When other adventurers approach Ilya, he cannot help but feel nervous, and this nervousness is conveyed to the animals, causing them to intimidate or even attack the visitors, further complicating his communication with others.
lang.爱丽丝，外号“月之子”，打出生开始就获得了月亮的祝福，在月光下可以:
Alice, also known as the 'Child of the Moon', has been blessed by the moon since birth, unleashing unparalleled power under the moonlight.
She plays the zither very well and often enjoys playing melodious songs under the moonlight in the middle of the night.
lang.奥拉哈姆是魔族有名的神射手。他喜欢与众不同的感觉，他认为如果弓箭手:
Oraham is a famous marksman of the Demon Clan. He enjoys the feeling of being different and believes that it would be boring if an archer only knows how to shoot arrows. Therefore, he spends his spare time studying magic books, which has also given him impressive magical proficiency.
On the battlefield, Oraham often shoots a single arrow, but enemies often fall in droves. He is a headache for the enemy.
lang.奥斯曼是森林中的一颗古树，不知已经在森林中存在了多久，在精灵出现之:
Osman is an ancient tree in the forest, and it's unknown how long he has existed there. He has been living in the forest for hundreds of years even before the appearance of elves.
He guards the Evolution Forest year-round, and any intruders who enter the forest are his targets of ATK.
lang.半人半吸血鬼的杀手，冷酷无情，话不多。\n 在完成任务:
A half-human, half-vampire assassin who is cold-blooded and ruthless, and doesn't talk much.
She is very serious and committed when completing missions and will not rest until the goal is achieved.
She dislikes bloodstains on her clothes and often wipes her blade repeatedly. She has an abnormal craving for blood.
lang.被火之邪神附身的少女，肉体被邪神影响停留在十六、七的样子，并失去了:
A girl possessed by the evil god of fire, her body remains in the appearance of being 16 or 17 and has lost her memory. During that time, she briefly joined the Demon Clan.
 In a battle with the elves, she regained her memories because her only friend was killed by her own uncontrollable self. After awakening, she helped the elves turn the tide and dealt a heavy blow to the Demon Clan.
lang.布兰德是吸血鬼的女王，她城府很深，甚少表露真实的情绪。\n:
Brand is the queen of vampires. She is very secretive and rarely reveals her true emotions.
She displayed extraordinary intelligence and a desire for power from a young age, and the voices of opposition within the clan gradually disappeared.
After Brand took the throne, the vampire clan reached its peak.
lang.传说中星河的护卫者，很少有人见过其真面目。关于她的传说一半很好，另:
The legendary guardian of the Milky Way, few have seen her true face. Half of the legends about her are good, and the other half are bad.
Mainly because she is both good and evil, she does things based on her mood, very capricious.
lang.从阿瓦隆当上众神殿之主的那天起，他就积极投身于建立一个理想的世界。:
From the day he became the leader of the Pantheon in Avalon, he has actively dedicated himself to building an ideal world.
For this reason, he launched a plan to purify the world by eliminating all races that represent evil and only preserving the so-called righteous races.
When the Demon Clan was heavily damaged, Xiao led the Godslayer Legion in a desperate resistance, severely obstructing Avalon's plan.
lang.帝国的秘密武器，看着是普通人，其实是由偶然获得的外星能量装置和本国:
The secret weapon of the Empire, it looks like an ordinary person, but it is actually a fusion of accidentally obtained alien energy devices and the country's top artificial human technology.
She has extremely terrifying combat abilities and, after merging with extraterrestrial technology, the android has begun to awaken some self-awareness and is no longer completely under the control of the empire.
Once, due to Zero's rampage, the military fortress she was in was completely razed to the ground.
lang.菲斯娜是魔族禁卫军的军团长。数百年前，老魔王将战争遗孤收养了起来，:
Fisna is the commander of the demon clan's imperial guard. Hundreds of years ago, the old demon king adopted war orphans and formed the royal exclusive imperial guard through rigorous training and selection. It is one of the strongest forces of the demon clan.
In the Imperial Guard, the strong rule. When Fisna was 10 years old, she defeated the former leader of the Imperial Guard and became the youngest commander in the history of the Imperial Guard!
lang.根据远古时期文字记载，魔王·安达利尔是从地狱中释放到这个世界的，考: According to ancient texts, the Demon King Andalir was released from hell into this world. Considering her betrayal, the ancient gods imprisoned her in the Crystal Palace. After being imprisoned for thousands of years, she became aggressive and possessed a pair of incredibly resilient legs. Additionally, her mouth is extremely unusual. Through her mouth, she can spray instantaneously lethal neurotoxins at enemies, sending chills down their spines.
lang.贾迪丝 常年在夜晚提着个精美的蛋糕篮子穿梭在乡间，向遇到的人推销她:
Jadis wanders through the countryside at night, carrying a beautiful cake basket to sell the cakes she made by herself to the people she meets.
But anyone who has eaten her cake has never been seen again.
lang.驾驶着泰坦机器人的琪琪，是机械帝国最好的驾驶员。\n:
Qiqi, who drives the Titan robot, is the best driver in the Mechanical Empire.
On the other hand, she is also the fastest in private... Her jokes often make boys blush.
lang.精灵族的牧师，非常热心肠，得知有人受伤后，她总是一脸兴奋的跑过去，:
The priest of the Sprite tribe is very enthusiastic. When she learns that someone is injured, she always runs over with excitement and shouts, 'Leave it to me!'
However, due to limited abilities, sometimes her healing spells are not effective, and she will keep muttering 'Huh? Huh? Huh?'
lang.精灵族的游侠队长，百步穿杨，箭术无双。平时话很少，给人一种高冷的感:
The captain of the Sprite tribe's archers, who has unparalleled archery skills. He rarely speaks and gives people a cold feeling.
She hates people who are late the most. After being promoted to captain, she made a rule that anyone who is late for training has to put an apple on their head as a target. Since then, no one dares to be late anymore.
lang.卡莉芙是枭的妹妹，从小被爱围绕的她在遭遇“那一夜”之后，性情大变。:
Carlyle is Owl's sister. After experiencing 'that night', when she was surrounded by love since childhood, her personality changed dramatically.
Carlyle never shows mercy, whether facing powerful enemies or DEFless civilians. She even finds pleasure in killing and tormenting.
Every time she faces her brother's preaching, Carlyle always looks aggrieved, leaving Leo helpless in the end.
lang.可可雅尔是月神一族的后裔，月神一族因阻挠了“寂”的暗杀行动而遭到了:
Cocayel is a descendant of the Moon God Clan. The Moon God Clan suffered a crazy revenge for obstructing the assassination actions of 'Ji', and young Cocayel lost all her family members.
But she never forgets the deep-rooted hatred in her heart. She can't forget the gaze of the witch Ieta that day and the despair it brought.
In the monastery, Cocayel is a gentle older sister; when facing the Demon Clan, she transforms into the fiercest warrior, brandishing her staff ferociously to eliminate all enemies.
lang.昆塔来自学院的一个古老的世家，她的家族坚信决定一切的是人而不是机械:
Quinta comes from an ancient family in the academy. Her family firmly believes that it is people, not machinery, that determine everything, so Quinta has received strict training since she was young.
At the age of 16, Quinta passed the final test to inherit her family and obtained the family's legacy exoskeleton armor, taking her strength to a higher level.
lang.拉瑞欧天生神力，手持一把巨大的镰刀。成天一脸无辜的模样，杀起人来十:
Lerio has innate divine power and wields a huge scythe. With an innocent look on his face all day long, he is extremely professional when it comes to killing.
However, she is completely clueless in life, being directionally challenged, clumsy, and forgetful.
lang.狼女双胞胎中的姐姐，是个严重妹控，战斗中总是站在妹妹前面，保护妹妹:
The elder sister of the werewolf twins, she is seriously obsessed with her younger sister. She always stands in front of her sister in battle, protecting her from harm.
For targets that put her sister in danger, she will not hesitate to deliver a destructive blow.
lang.利奥喜欢制造各种会飞的装置，他最得意是发明了一只机械鹰并起名为零度:
Leo enjoys creating various flying devices, and his proudest invention is a mechanical eagle named Zero.
Zero can convert Leo's magical power into gentle energy and transfer it to teammates.
Every time Zero heals a teammate, he shouts some chuunibyou magic names, thinking it's very cool.
lang.玲玲是光辉女神苏拉身边寸步不离的守护兽，一只雌性灵狼。\n:
Lingling is the guardian beast constantly by the side of the radiant goddess Sura, a female spirit wolf.
Lingling has a very keen sense of smell. When she meets someone gentle and kind, she will enthusiastically rush to seek cuddles. When facing enemies, she will be highly alert, growling lowly and preparing for battle.
In the fated confrontation between Sura and the witch Ieta, Lingling stepped forward to protect Sura and tragically fell into Lake Baikal.
After being revived by Yui, Lingling lost her memories but still remains the passionate and loyal guardian spirit wolf.
lang.罗塞特最开始是用一把枪的，但是她发现枪的后坐力太大，开完一枪后，整:
Rosette initially used a gun, but she found that the recoil was too strong. After firing one shot, her entire hand would be thrown back, and it would take a while for her to perform a second ATK.
So, she asked her superiors for another gun, thinking that she would be able to shoot continuously~
As a result, this time the whole person flew out.
lang.萝丝是吸血鬼中少见不喜欢用刀却喜欢用弓的，无论是否射中要害，萝丝从:
Rose is a rare vampire who dislikes using knives but prefers bows. Regardless of whether she hits a vital point or not, Rose always maintains a blank expression.
However, if she shoots more than 3 arrows at the same target, she is probably angry.
lang.玛格丽特身形娇小，看起来就是个小姑娘，然而她已经活了几百年了。\n:
Margaret has a petite figure and looks like a little girl, but she has actually lived for hundreds of years.
She is the second princess of the Bloodline. It is unknown what secret method she has practiced that has halted her physical and age growth.
In private, her favorite thing to do is to dress up as a little girl and act coquettishly towards young men.
lang.麦克斯是梵姆佩尔王国的星座专家和预言专家。\n 传说她:
Max is the constellation expert and prophecy specialist of the Vimper kingdom.
Legend has it that her predictions about love are very accurate, but she still wonders why she is still single.
lang.米莉亚家里往上数三代基本都是牧师，所以她觉得自己也应该继承家族传统:
In Milia's family, the past three generations have all been priests, so she feels that she should also inherit the family tradition.
Unexpectedly, as she grew older, Milia's fiery temper only intensified. Although she is still affiliated with the church, she often appears on the battlefield.
It didn't take long before the title of 'Violent Missionary' spread among enemies. Not only does she strike heavily, but she also loves to chatter.
lang.米斯打小在孤儿院长大，他打小自尊心就很强、而且一直希望将来能为国效:
Miss grew up in an orphanage since childhood. He had a strong self-esteem and always hoped to serve the country in the future.
Due to her exceptional efforts and talent, Miss graduated from the Imperial Military Academy with the highest score. She directly joined the empire's strongest airborne troops and was promoted to the position of combat team leader within six months.
lang.米斯拉小时候双亲在一次雪崩中丧生了，他被路过的龙族救下并抚养成人。:
When Miss was young, his parents died in an avalanche. He was saved and raised by passing dragon clan.
During the process of raising him, the Dragon Clan discovered his astonishing magical talent and granted him the secret arts of the Dragon Clan.
Over a decade later, Missla is already a well-known user of ice magic, despite her young age.
lang.男人们在谈论“九尾妖狐”王玉芝时，脸上的表情并非恐惧，而是贪婪，因:
When men talk about the 'Nine-Tailed Fox' Yuzhi Wang, their facial expressions are not fear but greed, because she is too beautiful.
Her exquisite figure and exposed skin are captivating, and no one would remember her cold-blooded nature of killing without hesitation.
As the leader of the 'Fox Spirit', Yuzhi Wang only does two things: things that make herself happy and things that eliminate what makes herself unhappy.
lang.努尔克虽然是半人马，但是从很久以前就为精灵族效力。她虽然是骑兵，但:
Although Nurk is a centaur, she has been serving the elven clan for a long time. Although she is a cavalry, she is also an excellent archer.
The only problem is her sadistic nature. When chasing her prey, she likes to swing her curved blade pretending to be an ordinary cavalry. When she catches up to the enemy and is parallel to them, she calmly sheathes her blade, pulls out her longbow from her back, and shoots the enemy like a hedgehog under their gaze.
lang.诺萨15岁时整个家族被仇家灭门，只有他侥幸活了下来，但也受了重伤。:
When Nosa was 15 years old, his entire family was wiped out by enemies. He was the only one who survived, but he was also seriously injured.
In order to save him, the empire conducted a large-scale modification of his body, with 70% of his body becoming mechanical.
As Nosa grows older, he constantly thinks about revenge. He is usually quiet and devotes all his energy to transforming his body to obtain greater combat power.
lang.欧洛斯出生时就觉醒了风、雷两种元素的力量，一时狂风大作、雷鸣电闪。:
Ouros awakened the power of wind and thunder when he was born. There was a strong wind and thunderclap at that time.
Her family is very wary of her and has imprisoned her on a distant island, leaving her to fend for herself.
By the time she reached adulthood, she had gained complete control over her powers and effortlessly destroyed the island that had imprisoned her.
Years of imprisonment have made her isolated, and anyone who offends her is in danger of being annihilated.
lang.骑士团团长贞丽娜从未品尝过失败的滋味。他是神族的战神、最锋利的矛，:
Knight Captain Zheng Lina has never tasted the taste of failure. He is the war god of the gods and the sharpest spear. No one can face him head-on and retreat unscathed.
He is the messenger of the gods, and the happiest thing for him is to fight side by side with the gods on the battlefield.
When there is a god by her side, Zheng Lina will do her best to showcase herself, increasing her strength by more than double.
lang.赛思是圣泉中流出去的一滴水，在一场意外后产生了智慧，学会了语言，从:
Seth is a drop of water that flowed out of the holy spring. After an accident, he gained wisdom and learned language, wandering in the jungle ever since.
Seth is kind and friendly when encountering members of the Elven race, but he immediately switches to a combat state and becomes extremely fierce when facing those outside of the Elven race.
lang.身穿重型盔甲的白发少女，手拿一把泛着寒光的冰剑，攻击时会冰冻住对手:
A white-haired girl wearing heavy armor, wielding an icy sword that emits a chilling light. It freezes the opponent when ATKing.
She likes beautiful things and enjoys gardening. She claims to have an exclusive formula for fertilizer and has a special fondness for blue roses.
lang.身为兔子女王，与兔子传统的娇小可爱的形象不同的是，豆豆喜欢各种巨大: As the Rabbit Queen, Doudou differs from the traditional cute and petite image of rabbits. She likes all kinds of huge things, huge weapons, huge shields, huge carrots, and even huge carrots.
lang.身为吸血鬼族杀手，格兰特常年穿着一件改良过的小斗篷，活动方便。\n:
As a vampire hunter, Grant always wears an improved cloak for convenience.
Grant is the youngest member of the assassin organization 'Silence,' but he is no less capable than the adults around him, which makes him very proud.
He loves the moment when the knife cuts open the prey's neck, whispering softly in their ear, 'Be careful.'
It is said that he doesn't want to take advantage of the other party, so even in a fair duel, he has already warned in advance. He is truly a proud and stubborn little devil.
lang.神族银翼骑士团成员，时刻穿着战斗铠甲，长期和魔族战斗让她已经习惯了:
A member of the Silver Wing Knights of the gods, always wearing battle armor. Long-term battles with the demon clan have made her accustomed to maintaining a fighting state because she fears her fellow clan members dying before her eyes again.
She constantly hones herself to become stronger, repeatedly teetering on the edge of death and emerging revitalized.
lang.弑神军团的将军，曾跟随枭率领魔族大军攻打众神殿。\n:
The general of the Godslayer Legion, once led the demon clan to ATK the Temple of Gods under the command of Xiong.
He single-handedly battles against the Ten Great God Kings and becomes a god in one epic battle.
lang.双胞胎姐妹俩，从出生开始就感情极好，虽然经常拌嘴，但是一刻也不曾分:
The twin sisters have had a close bond since birth. Despite often bickering, they have never been apart for a moment.
They don't like their own personalities, but they are very fond of each other's personalities. As a result, the cheerful sister is quiet and reserved, while the introverted sister is very enthusiastic.
lang.苏拉总挂在嘴边的一句话：光明伴随着黑暗前行，在族人心中苏拉是光辉的:
A word that Sura always says: Light accompanies darkness. In the hearts of her people, Sura is a symbol of radiance. In the eyes of her enemies, Sura is a fearsome goddess of war.
Unlike the high and mighty Avalon, Sura often fights side by side with her fellow clansmen on the battlefield and is a true 'soul leader'.
As the rift between the two factions deepens, opposing factions have gradually formed within the divine race, and both sides have drifted further apart.
lang.魍她是老魔王最小的徒弟，是禁卫军的总教官，她继承了老魔王的智慧与战:
She is the youngest disciple of the Demon King and the chief instructor of the Imperial Guard. She has inherited the wisdom and power of the Demon King. All members of the Imperial Guard are trained by her. She is the core and strategist of the entire army.
In order to better integrate into this army, she sacrificed her pure Demon Clan bloodline and fused it with Dragon Clan bloodline, becoming a half-dragon, half-demon existence. This action earned the utmost respect from all members of the army.
lang.薇薇安有些偏执，认准的事，就一定要做到底。\n 她最喜:
Vivian is a bit stubborn. Once she decides on something, she will do it to the end.
She enjoys helping others and has saved many people. Even if the person begs not to be saved, Vivian will not hesitate to rescue them.
lang.乌泽尔是学院机械师创作的一只精密的提线傀儡，然而金属盛行的时代，再:
Uzel is a sophisticated marionette created by the academy's mechanic. However, in the age of metal dominance, even the most perfect wooden machinery can only invite ridicule.
After being abandoned by the master, Uzel found that there was no place in the vast world that belonged to her. After countless lonely and helpless nights, Uzel met Xiong.
Xiao said to Uzel, 'You need to be loyal to yourself.' Since then, Uzel has been a member of the 'Godslayer Legion' and fights to find his own purpose.
lang.西支部的最高領導者。負責指揮西支部的烈焰騎士應對各種危機。 判斷力: The highest leader of the Western Branch. Responsible for commanding the Flame Knights of the Western Branch to deal with various crises. Highly discerning and commanding ability.
lang.希拉虽然是出身贵族名门，但是淑女的外表下，藏着一颗暴力的心。\n:
Although Hila comes from a noble family, beneath her ladylike appearance hides a violent heart.
Because she has chased and beaten up half of the boys in the kingdom since childhood, people have secretly given her the nickname 'the wildest dog in the country'. Her favorite weapons are two custom-made giant mechanical gauntlets.
lang.星空中的傀儡，可代替对应星级英雄升星: Puppets in the starry sky that can replace corresponding star-Lv heroes for star upgrades
lang.血族的传奇法师，使用极其稀有的鲜血秘法进行战斗。\n:
【'The legendary mage of the bloodline, using extremely rare blood magic in battle.'】
Dracula is a demon who craves the blood of mortals. He was the first king of the Vonper Kingdom when it was established.
His blood magic not only defies the laws of nature to prolong his life but also allows him to control other people's bodies and minds at will.
lang.伊布看起来个子小小的，却有着和身材完全不相符的神力。\n:
Eevee looks small in size, but possesses divine power that is completely disproportionate to its body.
Height is Eevee's Achilles' heel. Some unaware adults often suffer a great misfortune for mocking Eevee's stature.
Finally, Eevee, out of anger, chose the heaviest battle axe in the academy's arsenal as her weapon. From then on, no one dared to make fun of her anymore.
lang.萤小时候是个孤儿，他被一个神秘的东方组织抚养长大。所以她有着与精灵:
Ying was an orphan when she was little. She was raised by a mysterious organization from the East. That's why she has completely different attire from the elves.
People who are not familiar with Ying might think she is just a cheerful dancer who always smiles while dancing. However, those who know her a little bit shudder when they see her smile, feeling that her thoughts are inscrutable.
There was a gang of thieves who wanted to abduct Ying. Without saying a word, she obediently followed them. By morning, not a single thief in the camp survived.
lang.尤多拉是魔族100年来的唯一的魅魔血统的继承人。\n:
Yudora is the sole inheritor of the succubus bloodline in the demon clan for the past 100 years.
She grew up with Leo and can be considered his childhood sweetheart.
Yudora saw through Xiao's intentions of reviving the Demon Clan before considering their relationship. She deeply understands him, so although they like each other, neither of them has broken through the final barrier.
lang.由依见到逝去的生命总会情不自禁地落泪。\n 战火纷飞的:
Yui couldn't help but shed tears whenever she saw a departed life.
During the turbulent years of war, Yui shuttled between various shelters and relief organizations, saving countless lives.
When people express gratitude to her, she always blushes shyly and runs away.
lang.有人说奥路菲的笛声会使人舒适平静，也有人说奥路菲的笛声会让人死亡。:
Some say Aurofi's flute sound brings comfort and tranquility, while others say it brings death.
Her flute can soothe the trauma in her teammates' hearts and bring nightmares to her enemies.
The specific effect depends entirely on Aurofi's mood.
lang.与所有依耶塔忠实的仆人一样，“行刑者”布切尔心甘情愿为依耶塔效忠。:
Just like all loyal servants of Ieta, the Executioner Bucher willingly serves Ieta.
He loves her, knowing it's impossible, but still follows her devotedly.
The 'Executioner' bounty posters can be seen all over the major cities, as he roams the continent, embodying cruelty and death.
lang.從阿修羅當上眾神殿神將的那天起，他就積極投身在無盡的戰鬥之中。\n:
From the day he became the general of the Pantheon in Asura, he has actively engaged in endless battles.
For this reason, he constantly seeks battles with the Demon Clan in various places to enhance his strength.
When the Demon Clan was under attack, Raphael found Asura and dueled with him. Although no one knows the final result of the battle, Asura entered endless cultivation once again. When he returns from his cultivation, the true war god will arrive.
lang.寒冰巨龙是古神的造物，在日月升起后的第100年，古神在起源山谷创造了:
Frost Dragon is a creation of the Ancient God. In the 100th year after the rise of the sun and moon, the Ancient God created it in the Valley of Origins. No one knows how many dragons the Ancient God created at that time, but the first and earliest one was named 'Darija'.
Therefore, it is also known as the ancestor of dragons. It is huge in size, greedy and cunning, and possesses the power of ancient gods, making it almost invincible. In order to protect the treasure and wealth it plundered from all around, it destroyed the surrounding towns and occupied the Lonely Mountain, later known as the Ice Dragon's Lair.

lang.让我们点击飞艇，开始试炼吧。: Let's click on the airship and start the trial.
lang.这就是本次试炼的第一道关卡啦~: This is the first Lv of this trial~
lang.精灵之森是精灵族赖以生存的家园，为了拯救被数万年前众神之战所波及的卡达尔沼泽:
The Forest of Sprites is the home where the Sprite tribe survives. They have isolated themselves from the world to save the Kadar Swamp, which was affected by the war of the gods tens of thousands of years ago.
The Elf clan, guardians of the Forest of Elves, has been able to live in peace in this place. Even when the war breaks out, they firmly believe that the forest can take care of itself.
lang.每一个进入试炼宫殿的人都是各种族承认的英雄，但他们被传送进试炼宫殿的一瞬间，:
Everyone who enters the Trial Palace is recognized as a hero by various races. However, the moment they are transported into the Trial Palace, their names will appear on the dome.
The path of the trial is extremely dangerous, and so far no hero has been able to walk out of here alive. Remember these bones that were covered in dust for the glory of Yanaan Avenue. Their honor will eventually return to their homeland.
lang.明明应是清冷的墓地，这里全连空气都泛着神圣的弧光，洋溢着生命的力量。\n:
Although it should be a cold cemetery, the air here is filled with sacred arcs and the power of life.
This is the place where the gods fell, and it is also the place where future races hold ceremonies to honor the gods. They erected giant statues of humans here and come back to worship the gods at specific times.
lang.人类在诞生之初即为弱小，第一批人类建造了知识之城·迪马克希，在知识之城智慧代:
Humans were weak from the beginning of their birth. The first batch of humans built the city of knowledge, Dimaxi. In the city of knowledge, wisdom represents everything.
Gradually, humans have grown and gained recognition from other races, and the City of Knowledge has become the foundation for humans to thrive. People in later generations call it 'the Academy'.
lang.位于炽热岩浆旁边的千面神陨落之地，明明身处岩浆峡谷而高温难耐，却因为这里是千:
The Fallen Land of the Thousand-Faced God is located next to the scorching magma. Although it is in the magma canyon and the high temperature is unbearable, it has become a silent ruin because it is the place where the Thousand-Faced God fell, shrouded in deathly silence.
Here, there is always a strange and eerie atmosphere of silence. This is the holy land of the bloodline and the demon clan, and it is forbidden for all the kind races on the continent.
lang.亚南大陆上没有哪个地方的气候与水土彼此出更为诡异，元素之地是精灵族的试炼之地:
Nowhere on the continent of Ayana has a climate and soil as strange as each other, the Elemental Land is a trial ground for the elves.
Here, water flows from low to high, and the erupting volcano seems endless. The sunny weather quickly turns into thunderstorms, and fifty meters away, there is snow and frost in the air.
No living beings can survive here. Death and demons descend at the same time. Who would have thought that this place was once a fragrant forest filled with birdsong?
lang.在寥寥无几的文献记载中，这座位于亚南大陆中部的古城曾经一度繁荣昌盛。\n:
In the scarce literature records, this ancient city located in the middle of the Ayana continent once flourished and prospered.
The history of this ancient city can be traced back to ancient times. It once belonged to a civilization that was extinct in history. This civilization was once extremely glorious.
The knowledge of this civilization is obtained from a more powerful and intelligent creature that transcends the gods. However, it is also these creatures that destroyed this ancient city. Now, only a few houses can prove its former glory.
lang.在岩浆峡谷扭曲的道路上最终通往的是位于峡谷中心的小岛，那里有一扇沉默的大门，:
On the twisted road in the Magma Gorge, it eventually leads to a small island in the center of the gorge. There is a silent gate there, and there is no way to accurately describe the appearance of this gate. It is like a shadow connecting to an unknown world.
A deep abyss, full of temptations. You can only describe it with grievances, but you can never capture its true appearance.
Legend has it that as long as you can pass through the back door of the world, you can go to any era you want...
lang.在岩浆峡谷最深处，居住这一群供奉邪神的野蛮人，他们有着诸多骇人听闻的习俗，他:
In the deepest part of the Magma Gorge, live a group of barbarians who worship the evil gods. They have many horrifying customs and have erected tall statues of the evil gods in the depths of the gorge.
These barbarians have an irreconcilable hatred with the major races on the continent. They are unfriendly to all foreign creatures, and even hostile. All unfamiliar faces are abhorrent to them.
Especially for those who rashly intrude into the tribes, they cannot escape the fate of being sacrificed!
lang.葬龙谷是一片位于亚南大陆中部的峡谷，传说在巨龙翱翔于天际的年代，这里是巨龙们:
The Dragon Burial Valley is a gorge located in the middle of the Ayana continent. Legend has it that in the era when the dragons soared in the sky, this was the place where the dragons roosted.
Due to the impact of the war of the gods, the dragons have disappeared, and on this land, you can only see some sub-dragons that do not have pure dragon bloodline. Many people come here to explore the traces left by the true dragons in the past.
Perhaps there is still a true dragon lurking somewhere unknown on this continent!
lang.这里曾经是一片美丽的森林，因众神之战而毁灭，现在这里只有恶劣的坏境和能腐蚀所:
This used to be a beautiful forest, but it was destroyed by the war of the gods. Now there is only a harsh environment and water that can corrode all living creatures. It is isolated from the world, and only madmen and convicts live here. The power of demons prevails here because they are the embodiment of evil.
At the entrance of the forest, there is a huge windmill that guides people on their way home.
lang.这里曾经是隐藏在地下的无底深渊，没人这知道这个深渊中蛰伏着什么，但凡出现在深:
This used to be an unfathomable abyss hidden underground. No one knows what lurks in this abyss. Any creature that appears near the abyss will inexplicably die.
Above the abyss, there is a cold and eerie aura, and below the abyss, whispers often echo, as if it were an ancient spell. The sound seems to carry a certain kind of magic that can bewitch people's hearts.
In order to prevent inexplicable deaths, the major races on the continent joined forces to seal this mysterious abyss, turning it into a sewer. Perhaps there are ancient races unknown to humans among them.
lang.这里在混沌初开之际曾是众神聚集之地，后因众神之战爆发毁于一旦。\n 这里是:
This was once a gathering place for the gods at the beginning of chaos, but it was destroyed due to the outbreak of the war of the gods.
Here is the central battlefield of the gods. The once prosperous city of gods was completely destroyed in the war. The sky is covered with yellow sand, and all divine energy fills the ruins, making it unable to restore its former landscape for a long time.
lang.这片处在亚南大陆东面的蛮荒之地，曾经是魔蝎族的领地，众神之战后魔蝎族被毁灭。:
This is a wilderness located to the east of the Ayana continent. It used to be the territory of the Scorpion Tribe, but the Scorpion Tribe was destroyed after the war of the gods.
Nowadays, this place is a settlement of barbarian tribes, different from the peaceful and gentle Forest of Elves. The tribes here are fierce and brave. You can live here in the wilderness to temper your blood, and you will not be willing to become a fragile flower in a comfortable place.
They dislike comfort, are unruly, and even refuse to give their cities formal names.
lang.整理曾是荒野矮人的家园，他们在这里建立了高耸的城墙钢铁一样的堡垒，架在城墙上:
The wilderness used to be the homeland of the dwarves. They built tall fortress-like walls here. The heavy artillery mounted on the walls is daunting. Any weapon is insignificant in front of this fortress. However, it was affected by the war of the gods and the entire race suffered devastating blows.
From then on, the race of Wild Dwarves disappeared into the dust of history, and this site is now only left with a cannon tower that serves as evidence of the existence of the Wild Dwarves.

lang.<color=#8e713f>·出手顺序：</color>\n每回合开始时，根据:
<color=#8e713f>·Attack order:<color>
At the beginning of each round, the order of actions is determined based on the speed of units on the field. Changing speed during the process will affect the order of actions at the start of the next round.
(Note: The slow effect at the beginning of the battle will take effect in the first round)
lang.<color=#8e713f>·流血、点燃、诅咒、中毒：</color>\n 每:
<color=#8e713f>·Bleeding, burning, curse, poison:</color>
Receives fixed damage per round, and the more layers stacked, the higher the damage

<color=#8e713f>- Dizziness, Petrification, Freezing, Sleep:</color>
The hero cannot take action

<color=#8e713f> ·Seal:</color>
Units carrying this state cannot land critical hits and passive skills cannot be triggered

<color=#8e713f>·Weakness:</color>
Units carrying this state stop their actions for 1 round, and this state cannot be stacked

<color=#8e713f>·Silence:</color>
Units carrying this state cannot use skills

<color=#8e713f> ·Provoke:</color>
Units carrying this state will be forced to only use basic ATKs to ATK provocateurs

<color=#8e713f>·Skill hit rate:</color>
The actual hit rate of a skill's effect = effect hit attribute - effect resistance attribute

<color=#8e713f>·Buff stacking rules:</color>
Buffs of the same type stack by default. When there are multiple buffs of the same type, the effects are accumulated. Buffs that cannot be stacked will be specifically stated in the buff description.
lang.<color=#8e713f>★根据我方英雄职业：</color>\n可根据实际:
<color=#8e713f>★According to our hero's profession:</color>
Decide based on the actual profession of the heroes in battle. For example, if you have 2 tank-type heroes in battle, it is recommended to use the Holy Spirit Formation to enhance the protection of our other heroes.

<color=#8e713f>★According to the opponent's lineup:</color>
You can also decide based on the opponent's deployed heroes. To avoid certain specific range damages (such as Zero's ultimate move: ATKs all enemies in the first two rows), adjust the formation.

<color=#8e713f>★Change formation:</color>
If you encounter a battle that you can't win, adjusting your formation and fighting again may have a miraculous effect!
lang.<color=#8e713f>★升星的好处：</color>\n升星能大幅提升英:
<color=#8e713f>★Benefits of upgrading stars:<color>
Upgrading stars can significantly increase the attributes of heroes, and it is also the only way to upgrade hero skill levels.

<color=#8e713f>★How to upgrade stars:<color>
Open the 【Soul=>Evolution】 interface in the main menu, select the hero you want to upgrade, and follow the prompts to put in other designated heroes to upgrade. 6-star heroes can be directly upgraded in the Hero Cultivation interface!

<color=#8e713f>★Friendly reminder:<color>
Because of a mysterious power, not all heroes can reach the highest star level. Pay attention when cultivating heroes!
lang.<color=#8e713f>★注意职业搭配：</color>\n一个完整的阵容:
<color=#8e713f>★Pay attention to profession combinations:</color>
 A complete lineup generally consists of a guardian (responsible for protection and control); warrior, mage (responsible for dealing damage); priest (responsible for healing and buffs).

<color=#8e713f>★Pay attention to Camp Restraints:</color>
The Camp Restraint effect will bring considerable damage bonus in battle. It is also the key to victory to choose the counter camp according to the enemy camp.

<color=#8e713f>★Pay attention to formation combinations:</color>
Deploying heroes of specific camps in battle can also provide attribute bonuses. Reasonable formation combinations based on your existing heroes can greatly increase the win rate. You can check the specific combinations by clicking on the camp icon in the 'Hero Battle' interface.

<color=#8e713f>★Pay attention to skill combinations:</color>
Most heroes' skills can be combined with each other. For example, Dracula's first skill inflicts bleeding on the enemy, while Max's ultimate can stun bleeding units. There are more powerful combinations waiting for you to explore!

lang.<title>基礎規則<title/>\n1.王者爭霸由選拔賽和32強賽組成。\:
<title>Basic Rules<title/>
1.The Kingdom Battle consists of the Qualifying Match and the Top 32 Match.
2. On the second and fifth day of each league season, the top 128 players on the Champion League leaderboard will automatically participate in the competition.
3.The match format is a 1v1 single lineup confrontation mode.
4. If the battle exceeds the time limit, the side with higher total damage will win.
<title>Selection Match Rules<title/>
1.The selection tournament starts at 21:05 on the same day, with a total of 6 rounds. Each round consists of a preparation phase (for changing lineups), a betting phase (for participating in betting gameplay), and a battle phase.
2. Winning a round earns points for the qualifying match, while losing does not.
3. The final total score is equal to the qualifying match score plus a certain proportion of the Champion League score. The top 32 players in the total score ranking will participate in the Top 32 competition.
<title>32 Strong Match Rules<title/>
1. Top 32 Match starts after the qualifiers and is divided into four groups. It is a knockout tournament that determines the champion, runner-up, and third place.
2. The rank of the third place is determined by the total score of the top 4 in the qualifiers.
<title>Betting Rules<title/>
1. Each round of the competition will initiate betting on a specified event. You can place bets during the betting phase. You can only place one bet per round, and it cannot be changed.
2. Betting chips will be distributed at the beginning of each round.
3.If the guess is correct, you will receive chips with the corresponding odds. If it is wrong, the chips bet will be deducted.
4. After the Kingdom Battle ends, the chips will be automatically settled as league prestige that can be used to exchange items in the score shop.
<title>Reward Distribution<title/>
1.Rewards will be sent via mail based on the final ranking after the Kingdom Battle ends.
lang.<title>匹配規則<title/>\n1.公會戰每週舉行三場，開始時間分別在:
<title>Matching Rules<title/>
1. The Guild Battle is held three times a week, starting at 05:00 on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
Guilds above level 2 and with more than 5 active members are allowed to participate in battles (guilds that had more than 5 donations the previous day).
3.Guild battle matchmaking is cross-server matching, pairing guilds with similar strength as opponents.
4. If there is a bye (unable to find an opponent) during matchmaking, you cannot participate in this guild battle.
<title>Battle Rules<title/>
1.After the battle starts, guild members can select and challenge enemy strongholds in the battlefield. Each challenge consumes 1 challenge count. In this guild battle, each participant has a total of 2 challenge counts.
2. There are 3 difficulty levels to choose from for enemy strongholds (Easy, Normal, Hard). The higher the difficulty, the stronger the enemy's battle attributes (difficulty coefficient displayed on the challenge panel). Higher rewards, records, and stars can be obtained from successful challenges.
3. Challenge the ruins of captured strongholds. After a successful challenge, not only will you receive rewards, but you can also increase the guild-wide bonus BUFF (attribute bonus for all guild challengers).
4. Successfully challenging strongholds will earn more records, successfully challenging ruins will earn 5 records, and failing a challenge will earn 1 record.
Guild battles last for 8 hours, during which the number of stars from both sides will be counted to determine the winner (the side with more stars wins). Rewards will be distributed to both participating guilds and participants based on the match results.
<title>Reward Rules<title/>
1.Challenge Rewards: You can obtain rewards by challenging strongholds. Successful challenges offer relatively more generous rewards, while even failed challenges still grant some rewards. Rewards include Guild Contributions and Gold, and can be obtained after the challenge battle ends
2. Rewards depend on the ranking of members' performance within the guild. The higher the ranking, the more generous the rewards. Rewards will be calculated and sent via mail after the guild battle ends.
Match rewards: Rewards are distributed to the participants based on the match results. All members of the winning guild will receive golden treasure chests corresponding to the number of members in the guild, while the losing side will receive bronze treasure chests. Please strive for victory!

lang.<size=26><b>[紧急公告] 玩家数据恢复处理进程通知</b></siz:
【Emergency Notice】 Player Data Recovery Process Notification

Dear players,
Four days ago, a serious issue occurred with our third-party cloud server, causing some player account data to be lost.
We deeply apologize for this. Data recovery has been initiated, but due to the large amount of data and the need for manual verification, it is expected that the process will not be completed in the short term.
To minimize the loss and compensate for the time cost, we will provide the following compensation plan within three business days:
1. We invite you to create an account on a new server.
2. For players who have made purchases:
* Total consumption ≤ $30, compensation: [$50 voucher]
* Total consumption > $30, compensation: [$50 voucher + 1.5 times the consumption amount in vouchers]
3. For players who have not made purchases: compensation: [$30 voucher]
We understand that these compensations may not fully make up for your losses, but we hope they help alleviate some of the inconvenience.
If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to provide feedback through the form below:
Fill out the form!
You can also contact us through info@gqyzy.life

Maiden Academy Development Team

lang.<size=26><b>補償通知</b></size><br/>親愛的玩家，<b:
Compensation Notice
Dear Player,
Due to a severe malfunction in the third-party cloud server we partnered with, your account data has been lost. We sincerely apologize for this.
Over the past week, the entire development team has been working overtime to restore your data. Unfortunately, the lost data cannot be fully recovered.
To compensate for your loss, we are offering vouchers as compensation. Please claim them within 7 days and you can use them in the Trade Guild -> Treasure Vault.
We understand that this compensation cannot fully make up for your loss, but we hope it can alleviate your inconvenience.
Thank you again for your understanding and support. We will continue to strive to ensure that similar issues do not occur in the future and to provide a more stable gaming experience.

Maiden Academy Development Team
